text:
maya: Quick thought 1-week mini tutorial + one webinar to launch the new refapp benchmarks. Short, hands-on pieces for devs + a manager-facing ROI slide.
owen: Agree. Keep tutorials <10m each, focus on running the refapp locally and reading the bench CSV.
natalie: I'll draft 3 social posts (X/LinkedIn) and a short landing blurb. CTA variants: "Run the refapp" (dev) and "See the economics" (infra).
tom: For benchmarks headline: show median latency + a single cost multiple (e.g., "~4x cost improvement") and link raw CSV. Also include a tiny how-to to repro:
```
pip install redwood-client
redwood-bench --model rdx-3b --seq 512 --runs 5
```
sara: Ops question: where do leads go? recommendation: form -> HubSpot -> tag by track -> Slack alert #marketing-inbound. I'll draft webhook example.
maya: good. action items: natalie social + landing (tomorrow noon), tom bench CSV + repro snippet (EOD), sara routing + webhook (tom), owen: tutorial drafts (short videos + markdown code).
natalie: posting calendar for Wed 10am PT webinar (45m + 15m Q&A).
sara: webhook snippet for ops: curl -X POST https://hooks.hubspot.com/forms/v2/submit/XXXXX -d '{"email":"{{email}}","track":"mini-tutorial"}'
omw: will coordinate ambassadors to seed threads during week 2.
maya: great. I'll compile a one-pager and drop it here for review. :sparkles:
